Ravi: Postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-303. I rolled action items into epic RI-9011 so we can track owners/hand-offs. Please claim items and add ETA + JIRA links. Epic: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9011

Ravi: Short list:
- eviction backstop config + smoke tests -> owner needed
- update rollback playbook with staged rollback steps -> owner needed
- tune alert thresholds to reduce noise -> owner needed
- targeted RCA for recurring end-of-month spike -> owner needed

emily: I9ll take eviction backstop + smoke tests. Will create subtask and set ETA = 5 business days. @Nadia can you handle verification?

Nadia: Yep I can verify. I9ll add a staging job and a PASS checklist. Aim: next Tue.

Ravi: Suggested RACI for eviction backstop: emily (R), Ravi (A), Nadia (C). Agree?

emily: Works for me, I9ll add it to the ticket description.

sre-bot: Created JIRA RI-9012 "Eviction backstop + smoke tests" assigned to emily. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9012

Nadia: I9ll open the recurrence RCA ticket and tag with 'monthly-spike' + 'kv-eviction'. Creating RI-9013 now.

sre-bot: Created JIRA RI-9013 "Recurrence RCA: telemetry + synthetic" assigned to Nadia. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9013

Ravi: Good. For rollback playbook, include an explicit handoff note for oncall and a communication template (SRE -> Support -> PM). Who can own?

emily: I can draft the communication template but prefer Ravi to own the playbook update.

Ravi: I9ll own the rollback playbook update. ETA: 3 business days. I9ll also add a biweekly checkpoint on RI-9011 until we have two consecutive clean deploys.

Nadia: If RCA points to capacity, tag RI-9013 with 'dedicated-capacity' and estimate cost impact so infra can triage.

Ravi: Noted. Everyone drop an emoji when your subtask is linked so I can compile the actions table for ops review.

emily: :white_check_mark:

Nadia: :thumbsup:

Ravi: Thanks all, will share tracker update by EOD Friday.
